name: NG++ (Ratchet & Clank)
author: Keros
description: RAC1 edition: independent weapon experience and levels 1–10. Native progression core; kill-credit integration in development.

settings.name: Weapon XP
settings.description: Weapons gain experience from enemies they kill.

settings.name: Weapon level cap
settings.description: Highest level a weapon can reach.

settings.name: XP curve
settings.description: How each weapon's XP requirement grows at higher levels.

settings.name: Level-up notifications
settings.description: Show a notice when a weapon levels up.

settings.name: Weapon damage scaling
settings.description: Increase weapon damage with its level.

settings.name: Ammo capacity scaling
settings.description: Increase maximum ammo with weapon level where supported.

settings.name: Bomb Glove XP per level
settings.description: Experience needed for Bomb Glove to reach its next level. This value is independent of every other weapon.
